tasks.title: Proxmox community helper-script + submission to community-scripts repo
tasks.prompt: FIRST: read spec/006-platform-expansion/{requirements.md, design.md, acceptance/platforms.feature}. SECOND: write releases/platforms/proxmox/install-cubeos-lxc.sh per REQ-600/601/602. Test against PVE 9.1.9 (matches the production estate). Submit PR to the community-scripts repo per REQ-600. Document the install command in cubeos.app/platforms/proxmox.
tasks.acceptance_test: ssh root@<pve-test-host> 'bash <(curl -s file:///path/to/install-cubeos-lxc.sh) && pct list | grep cubeos'

tasks.title: Physical x86 USB installer image + Calamares-derived wizard
tasks.prompt: FIRST: read spec/006-platform-expansion/{requirements.md, design.md, acceptance/platforms.feature}. SECOND: extend the Packer x86_64 template to produce an installer USB variant per REQ-603/604/605. Use Calamares (or a stripped-down equivalent) for the partition/install wizard. UEFI default; BIOS-mode optional. Test on at least one physical x86 box + one QEMU instance.
tasks.acceptance_test: cd releases && packer validate platforms/x86-installer/packer.json && bash platforms/x86-installer/test-in-qemu.sh

tasks.title: Platform-support matrix page + regression-suite expansion + community onboarding doc
tasks.prompt: FIRST: read spec/006-platform-expansion/{requirements.md, design.md, acceptance/platforms.feature}. SECOND: publish cubeos.app/platforms with the matrix per REQ-610/612. Add releases/CONTRIBUTING-platforms.md per REQ-614. Extend the platform regression suite to include x86 physical (via QEMU) per REQ-608/609. (REQ-606/607) document BananaPi deferral + preserve releases/platforms/bananapi/ skeleton.
tasks.acceptance_test: bash scripts/platform-regression-x86.sh && bash scripts/platform-regression-pi5.sh && bash scripts/platform-regression-lxc.sh
